Here's a common chain of Opiate addiction:

  1. Receive an injury requiring painkillers

  2. Have a doctor prescribe Oxycodone or some other Opiate-based painkiller in a higher than normal dose

  3. Begin to develop dependency on Oxy or other painkiller, keep getting a script despite injury healing

  4. Doctor gets canned due to overprescribing, user no longer has source for addiction

  5. User turns to street opiates (IE Heroin) to feed their addiction, as opiate withdrawal is literally the worst withdrawal in the drug universe and can actually cause death in severe cases.

  6. Heroin addiction becomes too costly, potentially due to scarcity of heroin in the area, user turns to other drugs to fulfill the same need (IE Krokodil)
